name: Britten: War Requiem
description: Britten's War Requiem with the state orchestra and three choirs
details:
Benjamin Britten's War Requiem op. 66 with the Deutsche Staatsphilharmonie Rheinland-Pfalz under Tristan Meister, soloists Rebecca Blanz (soprano), Daniel Schreiber (tenor) and Hanno Müller-Brachmann (bass-baritone), the Oratorienchor der Christuskirche Karlsruhe, the Beethovenchor Ludwigshafen and the boys' choir Cantus Juvenum.

Thursday 20:00 in the Pfalzbau concert hall; repeated on 21 November in the Christuskirche Karlsruhe. Prices are not on the orchestra page; tickets via the Pfalzbau ticket shop.
